messages.content: Extract knowledge graph triples from tech news. Output JSON with year, knowledge_type, and triples array. Each triple contains entity1, relation, entity2, relation_type, hierarchy_level. Relations must be from: release, propose, invent, create, develop, design, manufacture, acquire, invest, cooperate, apply, surpass, cause, replace, integrate, upgrade, based_on, is, belong_to, contain, host, serve_as, overcome, verify, discuss, has_feature. Output JSON only, no explanation.
Tesla plans to produce humanoid robots at scale in 2026.
